create_metrics_logger: create a MetricsLogger instance to collect scalar metrics during experiment runs
log_scalar_metric: log a scalar metric value with an optional step number to the MetricsLogger queue
get_last_metrics: retrieve all logged metric entries since the last call to get_last_metrics
create_scalar_metric_log_entry: create a ScalarMetricLogEntry container with a name, step, timestamp, and value
linearize_metrics: group a list of ScalarMetricLogEntries by metric name into steps, values, and timestamps
